title: Choose the visual world for brickbot.ro (familiar hand)
question: The familiar end: three of my grounded directions plus the category standard, each with a rough first-screen sketch. This is the second re-roll; if none fits, use Steer to tell me what's missing (a feeling, a site you like, something to avoid).

options.label: Matchday Broadcast
options.lineage: sports and FTC livestream on-air graphics
options.thesis: The home page broadcasts this season: DECODE's results as on-air graphics over full-bleed match photography.
options.viewport: The Worlds celebration photo fills the screen. A score bug top left (DECODE · 2025–26 · #15996), a giant lower-third 'Division finalists, FIRST Championship 2026', and a burgundy ticker running this season's results along the bottom.
options.risk: Broadcast graphics are familiar from sport and esports; the bars must stay crisp and editorial or it turns into a gaming overlay.

options.label: High Voltage
options.lineage: electrical warning plates and machine rating plates
options.thesis: BrickBot labelled like live equipment: the brand yellow as enamel warning plates, and this season's results stamped on a rating plate.
options.viewport: A big yellow warning plate with the bolt and 'High voltage since 2016', and beside it a stamped rating plate listing DECODE's results line by line. Match photos run below.
options.risk: Hazard signage is a well-worn industrial look; it needs restraint and real photography to avoid feeling like a construction site.

options.label: Main Event Bill
options.thesis: This season billed like a main event: towering condensed type, duotone photos, the result as the headline act.
options.viewport: Left: 'FTC #15996 presents · Season DECODE' in towering condensed caps, 'Worlds division finalists' on a burgundy band. Right: the celebration photo as a yellow duotone, full height.
options.risk: Fight-poster energy can feel combative; FIRST values cooperation, so the billing must celebrate rather than taunt.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark team site with a yellow accent, built to the level of team254.com and citruscircuits.org.
canonCard.viewport: The team photo with a headline and two buttons, then the season, posts and sponsors.
canonCard.risk: Close to the removed first attempt; it looks like every other strong team's site.
